pace.text: Lit dots = quota left. The hollow dot is even pace: where you'd be if usage were spread evenly across the window. Lit dots stopping short of it means you'll run out before the reset.

credits.text: Type: Doto and Fragment Mono (Google Fonts, OFL). Wallpapers in greyscale, via Wikimedia Commons: “Stornøkkvatnet in Winter, Lofoten, Norway” by Christoph Strässler, CC BY-SA 2.0; “Dusk San Cassiano” by Adam Singer, CC BY 2.0. All quota numbers are samples.
